title: The County and Suicide Prevention Council present latest local numbers on suicide
description:
Join County Vice Chair, Monica Montgomery Steppe and the Suicide Prevention Council live for the most recent data on suicide in the region. The annual “SPC Report to the Community” provides an in-depth look at case numbers, trends and high risk demographics.
